summary: The Ghostly Bear is a mysterious spectral Titan that resides in an abandoned mine. It appears as a phantasmic glowing green bear dressed in wooden geometric armor and decorated with tribal carvings.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Like the bear Titan [[Breaker]], the Ghostly Bear is tied to the Native Americans cultures, where the bear was seen as a protector and a bridge between the earthly and spiritual realms.

The Ghostly Bear guarded a mine shaft in a secluded mine, which made many believe it to be haunted. When the Huntik team investigated, they needed to have a consultation with the Ghostly Bear in order to escape. {{Source|TCG:SAS-153|SAS-153}}

The Ghostly Bear guarded a mine shaft in a secluded mine, which made many believe it to be haunted. When the Huntik team investigated, they needed to have a consultation with the Ghostly Bear in order to escape. [TCG:SAS-153]

The '''Ghostly Bear''' is a mysterious spectral [[Titan]] that resides in an abandoned mine. It appears as a phantasmic glowing green bear dressed in wooden geometric armor and decorated with tribal carvings. 

== History ==
Like the bear Titan [[Breaker]], the Ghostly Bear is tied to the Native Americans cultures, where the bear was seen as a protector and a bridge between the earthly and spiritual realms.

The Ghostly Bear guarded a mine shaft in a secluded mine, which made many believe it to be haunted. When the Huntik team investigated, they needed to have a consultation with the Ghostly Bear in order to escape. {{Source|TCG:SAS-153|SAS-153}}

== Abilities ==
The Ghostly Bear's illusory appearance is enough to scare away intruders, giving the mine its haunted reputation.  Its "Mystic Consultation" ability allows Seekers to come face to face with it and negotiate for their freedom. {{source|TCG:SAS-177|SAS-177}}
